\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsbsy}
\ifdefined\hatprobewithamsmath\usepackage{amsmath}\fi
\newcommand\hatprobe[2]{%
  \setbox0=\hbox{$#2$}%
  \typeout{HAT #1: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}%
  \noindent #1: \copy0\par
}
\tracingoutput=1
\showboxbreadth=100
\showboxdepth=100
\begin{document}
\hatprobe{mathbf-outside}{\mathbf{\hat{x}}}
\hatprobe{mathbf-inside}{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}
\hatprobe{boldsymbol-outside}{\boldsymbol{\hat{x}}}
\hatprobe{boldsymbol-inside}{\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}}
{\mathversion{bold}\hatprobe{mathversion-bold}{\hat{x}}}
\hatprobe{mathnormal-outside}{\mathnormal{\hat{x}}}
\hatprobe{mathnormal-inside}{\hat{\mathnormal{x}}}
\hatprobe{mathnormal-mathrm}{\mathnormal{\mathrm{\hat{x}}}}
\hatprobe{mathbf-mathnormal}{\mathbf{\mathnormal{\hat{x}}}}
\hatprobe{mathnormal-mathbf}{\mathnormal{\mathbf{\hat{x}}}}
{\mathversion{bold}\hatprobe{bold-mathnormal}{\mathnormal{\hat{x}}}}
\end{document}
